summary: Iteration 145 — Wrap Command Center Phase 2C both-side testing. BACKEND 21/21 PASS (test_iteration145_wrap_phase2c.py). FRONTEND 100% of review_request flows verified PASS on viewport 1920x1100 with admin thesigntistslab@gmail.com. BACKEND COVERAGE: GET /api/wrap/items/{id} returns top-level design/contract/approvals/pipeline_state blocks; legacy docs auto-backfill defaults via _serialize. PUT /design with single-field subset uses exclude_unset and preserves other fields (verified design_brief persisted while only style_direction was sent on 2nd call). PUT /design {proof_status:'approved'} also flips approvals.proof_approved=True + timestamp. POST /design/send-questionnaire sets questionnaire_status='sent' + ISO sent_at. POST /design/proofs returns new proof {id,label='V1',status='draft',notes,created_at,approved_at:null}. PUT /design/proofs/{id} {status:'approved'} sets approved_at, design.proof_status='approved', approved_proof_id, AND approvals.proof_approved=True+timestamp. DELETE /design/proofs/{id} removes it. PUT /contract subset persists; unspecified fields untouched. POST /contract/action: generate_draft -> contract_status='draft' AND seeds DEFAULT_TERMS_SUMMARY only when empty (verified custom terms preserved on 2nd generate_draft). send -> 'sent' + idempotent contract_sent_at. mark_viewed -> 'viewed' + idempotent ts. mark_signed -> 'signed' + accepted_terms=True + signed_by + approvals.contract_signed=True+ts. store_signed -> 'stored' + signed_contract_url. Invalid action returns 400 with allowed list. PUT /approvals: each key true sets {key}_at; idempotent (true->true preserves existing ts); false clears ts to null. POST /draft-updated-quote-message returns {to,subject,body,quote_amount,deposit_amount,balance_amount,order_number,vehicle_summary,wrap_type,customer_name}; subject='Updated Wrap Quote for Order #ORD-0018'; body contains 'Payment link will be connected in a later phase.'; deposit=quote/2 rounded, balance=quote-deposit; quote_amount equals pricing_snapshot.quoted_price ($2037.60). pipeline_state derivation correct: measurements_complete (areas.included), estimate_complete (snapshot.quoted_price>0), quote_sent (approvals.quote_approved), contract_sent ({sent,viewed}), contract_signed ({signed,stored} OR approvals.contract_signed), deposit_paid, proof_sent ({sent,revision_requested}), proof_approved ('approved' OR approvals.proof_approved), complete (approvals.final_signoff_completed). Non-wrap guard returns 400 'not a wrap category' on all 7 new endpoints. No mongo _id in any response (recursive check). Phase 2A/2B regression smoke: GET /items shape intact, POST /recalculate refreshes snapshot. FRONTEND: /orders/118b7377-.../items/aa0387f8-.../wrap-command-center loads; wrap-cc-status-bar present with 15 chips (data-testid prefix wrap-status-chip-{slug}, 6 emerald=measurements/estimate/quote-sent/contract-signed/deposit-paid/approved, 1 violet=contract-sent (active first non-complete), 8 slate). DESIGN TAB: all 10 fields render (style_direction/brand_colors/required_text/services_to_feature/design_brief/design_notes/artwork_notes/revision_notes/select-mockup_status/select-proof_status). Typing fires design-unsaved-indicator. design-save-btn persists. design-send-questionnaire-btn flips design-questionnaire-status to 'Sent'. design-add-proof-btn with design-proof-label='PW-V1' appended a design-proof-row-{id}. proof-approve-{id} approved it AND flipped approval-toggle-proof_approved to checked. proof-delete-{id} removed the row. CONTRACT TAB: contract-status-chip text reflects status. All 6 action buttons (generate_draft/send/mark_viewed/mark_signed/store_signed/download) render. generate_draft -> chip 'draft'. mark_signed (with contract-input-signed_by='Keith Johnson') -> chip 'signed' AND approval-toggle-contract_signed becomes checked. store_signed renders signed_contract_url as a link. APPROVAL CHECKLIST: 7 approval-row-{key} rows + approval-toggle-{key} toggles render for quote_approved/contract_signed/deposit_paid/proof_approved/inspection_acknowledged/final_signoff_completed/aftercare_sent. Toggling on persists with timestamp shown (e.g., '5/18/2026, 12:35:45 AM'). QUOTE DRAFT MODAL: contract-draft-quote-btn AND pricing-draft-quote-btn both open quote-draft-modal. Modal contains quote-draft-subject ('Updated Wrap Quote for Order #ORD-0018'), quote-draft-body (multi-line with 'Hi TEST_TaxCustomer_exempt2_b5ea0b77' greeting + vehicle '2023 Mercedes' line), quote-draft-meta (Customer/Order/Vehicle), quote-draft-amount ('Quote: $2037.60'). quote-draft-close closes modal. PHASE 2A/2B REGRESSION FE: vehicle tab still renders vehicle-save-btn; pricing tab renders pricing-save-btn/pricing-apply-btn/pricing-draft-quote-btn. NON-WRAP REDIRECT: /items/e19d6501-.../wrap-command-center silently redirects to /orders/118b7377-... (URL after nav confirmed).

issues: Browser console accessibility warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}'. Cosmetic a11y warning only; functionality intact. Add a <DialogDescription> (or aria-describedby) to silence.

action_items: Optional a11y polish: add DialogDescription to QuoteDraftModal to clear the console warning.
Optional: ContractAction.action could use a Literal type for clearer 422 responses on bad clients instead of the current 400-with-allowed-list (current behaviour matches spec).
critical_code_review_comments: wrap.py _set_approval correctly implements timestamp idempotency: it only writes {key}_at when value is True AND no existing ts, and writes null when value is False. Clean and reusable.
_serialize uses setdefault for the new design/contract/approvals blocks and also backfills any missing APPROVAL_KEYS — old wrap_data docs work without migration. Good defensive coding.

contract_action 'send' / 'mark_viewed' / 'mark_signed' use 'contract.contract_sent_at': contract.get(...) or _now() — preserves the original timestamp on repeated calls (idempotent). Verified by tests.
DEFAULT_TERMS_SUMMARY only seeded when terms_summary is falsy; subsequent generate_draft calls never overwrite custom terms. Verified by test_contract_generate_draft_seeds_terms_only_if_empty.
_pipeline_state derivation lives in the route module — fine for now; if more chip rules accumulate consider moving to a small services/wrap_pipeline.py helper for unit testability.
draft-updated-quote-message gracefully falls back when there's no order/customer (uses 'there' as first name, empty order_number drops the # from subject). No 500s observed.

wrap.py is now 1146 lines and growing — at the >700-line threshold from the code-review guidelines. Consider splitting into wrap/models.py, wrap/pricing.py, wrap/design.py, wrap/contract.py to keep modules focused before Phase 3.

Minor: contract_action 'store_signed' allows status flip even when signed_contract_url is None — leaves the field as whatever was previously stored. Likely intentional (idempotent store), but a 422 when the URL is required would be safer.
QuoteDraftModal: shadcn Dialog is missing a DialogDescription — produces a React a11y console warning on every open. Cosmetic only.
_id leakage check in test suite is recursive and confirmed clean across all Phase 2C endpoints.
seed_data_creation: Used pre-seeded wrap ticket aa0387f8-... (already has vehicle_info, wrapped_areas, materials, pricing_snapshot from prior iterations). Tests deterministically reset proof_status / approvals.proof_approved at the end of approval-related cases. After the run, the wrap doc has contract.contract_status='stored', signed_contract_url='https://example.com/signed-contract.pdf', signed_by='Keith Johnson', approvals.contract_signed=True/quote_approved=True/deposit_paid=True/proof_approved=True (toggled via UI run), questionnaire_status='sent'. Main agent can reset by clearing fields via the UI or by calling PUT /approvals with each key false and PUT /contract with empty fields if needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2C is fully wired and verified. wrap_data Mongo doc now stores design/contract/approvals blocks + pipeline_state derived on read. The status chip prefix is `wrap-status-chip-{slug}` (NOT `wrap-chip-`). QuoteDraftModal renders into a portal but data-testid='quote-draft-modal' still resolves via Playwright. The draft-updated-quote-message endpoint returns an email draft object (NOT the wrap doc) — frontend correctly does not setWrapData with it. Approval timestamps are ISO strings; UI renders via new Date().toLocaleString(). Phase 2A/2B regressions all clean: vehicle PUT still mirrors specs.vehicle_*; apply-price-to-order still rolls up order_total. Mocked / placeholder still: AI helper buttons on every tab (toast-only), Contract Download button (alert), QuoteDraft 'Send Later' button (toast).
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Phase 2C implementation matches every spec bullet (design CRUD, contract actions w/ idempotent timestamps + terms seeding rule, approvals timestamp idempotency, draft email math, pipeline_state derivation, non-wrap guard, _id stripping, Phase 2A/2B regression intact).
